name: rkyv
clone_method: git clone --depth 1 (shallow, .git removed post-clone; commit_sha recorded via git rev-parse HEAD before removal)
license_evidence: LICENSE file at repo root, verified by direct read: 'Copyright 2021 David Koloski' followed by standard MIT permission/warranty text. Workspace Cargo.toml also declares license = "MIT" for all crates.
framing_note: Donated as a Rust-native zero-copy archive-format reference. rkyv's own docs (book_src/feature-comparison.md, read verbatim in this census) state 'Schema evolution: no' and 'Cross-language: no' for itself, versus 'yes'/'yes' for Cap'n Proto and FlatBuffers -- this is rkyv's own claim, confirmed by reading its source, not an assumption carried in from the census brief. Recommended for Atlas's ephemeral/internal cache artifacts (e.g. local systemize-output cache) where producer and consumer share one build, NOT for the long-lived, cross-version-compatible .atlas/.atlasx portable artifact.
